sections.heading: Introduction
sections.text: Surprise Gift is a Quest in Escape from Tarkov.

sections.heading: Dialogue
sections.text: "I heard you got involved in this affair with Fence and Ref. So of course you decided to come to me. You want to mess with Ref? Hmm, that would be beneficial to me. Bring me the dirt on him, and I'll find a way to use it."

sections.heading: Requirements
sections.text:
- Must be level 35 to start this quest.
- Must accept Fence's quest Between Two Fires to obtain this quest.

sections.heading: Objectives
sections.text:
- Return to the old champion's hideout on Customs
- Locate and obtain the compromising information on Ref
- Hand over the found info

sections.heading: Rewards
sections.text:
- +25,500 EXP
- Lightkeeper Rep +0.01
- 1,187 Dollars
"I'm glad you understand who it's more advantageous to be friends with."

sections.heading: Failure Dialogue
sections.text: "So why even come to me in the first place if you're just going to give the intel to one of those two?"

sections.heading: Guide
sections.text:
By completing Between Two Fires or Decisions, Decisions, you will fail and lose access to this quest.
| Item name | Amount | Requirement | Find in raid | Notes |
| Dorm overseer key | 1 | Required | N/A | Unlocks the room between 209 and 211 in the three-story dorms on Customs. |
| Ref dirt | 1 | Handover item | Yes | This quest item can only be found if the quest is active.; When picked up, this item is transferred to the player's quest item inventory.; If the player fails to extract with this item, they will lose it. |

The champion's room is located on the second floor of the three-story dorms building on Customs, between the rooms 209 and 211. A Dorm overseer key is required to enter it.

The compromising information can be found on the floor in a puddle of blood next to the wardrobe.
